items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: When I was a kid when I first met him... That's where we used to practice.

ctx.x: He was a good musician. He could play pretty well. When I was a kid when I first met him, you see, him and Tom were always together. They lived in the first house down that land.
John Soxland, John Soxland they call it.
Well, that's where we used to practice. Not once a week, every day.
